By using Python 3.10 for your app, you can leverage the latest language and runtime improvements in Python. To Python 3.10 in your Azure functions, please use Functions version 4.x.

Azure Static Web Apps support for Python 3.10 follows the Python 3.10 lifecycle. Learn more about Python and other language support in Static Web Apps here.
